StationRecordID SR-901 | CampaignID C-17 | SiteCode BR-4 | Date 2026-10-14. The record explicitly binds SampleBatchID SB-031 and AssetTag CTD-204 to CampaignID C-17. At 10:15 CEST, salinity was 12.6 PSU, water temperature 15.8 °C, and turbidity 2.1 NTU.

At 10:40 CEST, the same SampleBatchID SB-031 has a second salinity reading of 12.9 PSU. Peak turbidity for SR-901 was 3.6 NTU. The record specifies no averaging rule and does not designate either salinity reading as the sole current value.

LabReportID LR-550 | SampleBatchID SB-031. Nitrate: 0.84 mg/L. Laboratory pH: 7.43. Phosphate: not tested. The report says SampleBatchID SB-031 was received from StationRecordID SR-901. Finalized 2026-10-16 by M. Caron.
A separate entry for SampleBatchID SB-013 reports nitrate 0.48 mg/L. SB-013 is not the batch analyzed in LR-550.

The snapshot remains current in the filing system. No revision note reconciles this register date with CalibrationCertificateID CAL-204A; neither record is marked superseded.
